newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower on renewed pressure.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower on renewed pressure.

text.p: UK grain futures closed lower on Friday following forecasts of good weather over the weekend.

"The weather looks good for the weekend which will help the harvest. It's also begining to look as if some of the milling wheat won't make the grade which means there is going to be more feed wheat around than people thought," said a trader.
Wheat futures closed 1.15 to 1.30 stg down after trading 635 lots while barley was one to 0.20 stg down on 53 lots.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures market closed unchanged after trading one lot in December at 278 marks.
UK cash trade was slow with traders on the fob market reporting November feed wheat trading at 113 stg a tonne fob east coast ports.
Delivered business was mainly for spot material with between 109 and 110.50 stg being paid for feed wheat depending on area and 104.50 to 105 stg for feed barley.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein traded at between 133 and 135 stg for Oct/Dec depending on area.
